metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods made by anderson-spider.

plugins.name: branch-guard
plugins.description: Holds a git commit or git push on the protected branch and shows what would go in, with Proceed and Cancel.

plugins.name: chatgpt
plugins.description: Lets Claude ask your logged-in ChatGPT, or have it generate an image, through terminal-browser, and saves the result locally.

plugins.name: codex-computer-use
plugins.description: Routes native Mac app control through Codex computer use from the ChatGPT app, with per-app approval, one Codex session per Claude session or subagent, and /codex-cu on|off.

plugins.name: codex-team
plugins.description: Lets Claude lead Codex or Claude agents: execute, review and loop run them in Herdr panes as background jobs, with a band above the prompt and a report per job.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Lets Claude query and modify the tailnet through the Tailscale API, using TS_API_KEY.

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: A usage line above the prompt (context, 5-hour and 7-day limits against the clock, the prompt cache, the subagents running) and suggested next prompts you can pick, in order, into one draft.
